up: Retrieve the compound ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds that have exact activity values (standard_relation = '=') for assay CHEMBL1741325. Deduplicate by compound.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM assays a
JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741325'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
